data.one_liner: A* pathfinding algorithm for integer grid with barriers
data.what_it_does: Computes the shortest path between a start and end point on a rectangular grid using the A* algorithm. Returns an iterable of (row,column) tuples representing the path. Supports optional diagonal movement and barrier cells.
use_when: You need simple grid‑based pathfinding without Flutter dependencies
The project is pure Dart and you want a lightweight solution
avoid_when: You need asynchronous streaming of results or real‑time updates
strengths: Simple, declarative API with tuple coordinates
Handles barriers and optional diagonal moves
weaknesses: May not scale well for very large maps
